os.makedirs(p,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = n // 2
    out = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        if r <= center:
            out[r][center-r] = 2
            out[r][center+r] = 2
        else:
            for c in range(n):
                if (c-r-center) % 4 == 0:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
